text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
Wha... scuttling around like that...! 
...HAAAAAH...!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you missed! And Gentildonna-senpai! 
That fake—...is a physical "object", you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is good news. 
Then—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Imitation. 
From here on, I shall be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Earlier, you claimed that your appearance 
and strength 
were identical to mine, did you not?

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
ThAt'S rIgHt, "IdEnTiCaL"! 
So YoU cAn NeVeR bEaT mE!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No, you are mistaken. Down to every last 
detail.

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
Ha... NoT mIsTaKeN! We JuSt TiEd!! 
ThIs FoRm AnD sTrEnGtH aRe ThE sAmE aS 
yOuRs!!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
A being that destroys the happiness of 
others! That has destroyed it all along! 
Filled with the power to destroy!!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
JuSt LiKe YoU! 
I tOoK yOuR fOrM jUsT tO dEsTrOy!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why you are different 
from me. 
You cannot—defeat me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In the end, all you have gained is the 
power to "destroy happiness." 
A mere thing that sought strength solely 
for destruction.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: However, the true essence of my power—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...—is that which carries me to victory!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Radiant, magnificent! 
That which leads me to the pinnacle is my 
true strength!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yet as a mere imitation, you lack it! 
You do not possess the "power to attain 
victory" that is inherent to me!!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text: Guh... AAAAAAH!? AAAAAAAAGH!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Those whose sole purpose is destruction 
have no need to win. 
—And within those who have no need to win, 
the power to achieve victory will never 
dwell.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You will never surpass me for the rest of 
your existence. 
—For I am the strong, and I am the victor!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And the power to attain victory... 
is accumulated by turning one's goals and 
hopes into blood and sweat.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally, the "happiness" you despise so 
much serves as nourishment as well.

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
No! WrOnG! No!! YoUr TrUe EsSeNcE iS tHe 
SaMe As MiNe! 
WhAt DiD yOu BrInG aBoUt WiTh ThOsE 
vIcToRiEs!?

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
YoU tRaMpLeD oN tHe HaPpInEsS oF oThErS!! 
JeAlOuSy, HaTrEd, YoU'vE gAtHeReD aLl 
ThOsE nEgAtIvE eMoTiOnS!!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
ThE vIcToRy YoU sPeAk Of Is ThE sAmE aS 
wHaT tHiS mAnSiOn HaS gAtHeReD! 
YoUr BoDy Is ThE sAmE aS mInE! WhAt YoU'vE 
oBtAiNeD iS nEgAtIvE eMoTiOn!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
HaVe PeOpLe NeVeR pOiNtEd FiNgErS aT yOu!? 
IsN't ThAt ViCtOrY cOrRoDeD bY cUrSeS!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Every single one of my victories is my 
pride!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to point fingers behind my 
back, do as you please. 
However—I shall never lower these arms 
that have seized glory!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Victory is the ultimate "pinnacle" of 
which all beings dream! 
I know its true worth better than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, for today's victory as well—I 
shall take immense pride in it.

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh... AAAAAAAAAAAAAAGHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Now, grit your teeth.
(KABOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, my Muses! Gather 'round! 
Let's take a truly beeeautiful photo! 
Three... two... one...!"
(Click!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah~~, so cute! 
A perfect 300-mile flower mark! I'm so 
glad we took a photo here~!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo wants to take photos in the grand 
hall too! 
I'll dance around and make my skirt 
flutter fluffily!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu. But before that, one more! 
...Would it be alright to take some pair 
photos too?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm~~, of course! We've got plenty of 
time! 
Let's keep snapping away!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for your hard work, 
Gentil-san."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Likewise. 
Though there were a few tribulations along 
the way."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...However, in the end, we won. 
We are the ones who seized victory."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hohoho... 
Well said."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...—And so, the mansion that devoured 
happiness... 
was defeated... by the happy Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Yet why was the ghost who ruled the 
mansion... 
so obsessed with... 'destroying 
happiness'... I wonder..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"At first... just like the ghost 
brides......... 
Perhaps it had lingering regrets... deeply 
precious regrets..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
".........However, even that. It forgot. 
It became so absorbed in destroying... 
that it became its sole purpose.........—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It ended up destroying... even 
itself..........

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Attaining happiness is difficult... 
Seeing others prideful of their happiness 
evokes envy..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And if one persists only in envy, 
jealousy, and tearing others 
down..........

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
".........In the end, you may lose sight 
of... 
the true shape of happiness you once 
sought............"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Phew—...
